request: Analyze GSE327036 for the paper (Loss of STARD7 Impairs Mitochondrial Phospholipid Homeostasis and Contributes to Mitochondrial Myopathy): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (poly(A) mRNA, Illumina), mouse soleus muscle
final.sample_inclusion: soleus from Stard7 flox/flox control (Cont) and Myf5-Cre; Stard7 flox/flox muscle-specific KO (mKO) mice, n = 3 biological replicates per group (S2.5.p1, FLT.p3)
final.exercise_in_rnaseq: none: treadmill running (S2.3.p1) and lactate tests (S2.4.p1) are phenotyping assays; the RNA-seq samples (S2.5.p1, S3.3.p1) are not described as exercised or as harvested after a bout, and no exercise arm exists in the transcriptome design
final.primary_estimand: genotype effect (STARD7 mKO vs control) on soleus gene expression at baseline; not an exercise effect
planned_contrasts: mKO vs Cont in soleus (FLT.p3 Fig. 3B/3C; paper DEG count not stated in text; named down genes Mybpc2, Actn3, Pvalb, Mct4 (Slc16a3), Myh4; Myh7 unchanged)
final.normalization: CLC Genomics Workbench counts -> TPM, log2(TPM+1) for PCA/heatmap (S2.5.p1); edgeR with filterByExpr for DE (FLT.p3)
final.paper_method: edgeR (filterByExpr) mKO vs Cont, analysed in OlvTools
final.paper_results: Fast-twitch genes Mybpc2, Actn3, Pvalb, Mct4, Myh4 down in mKO; Myh7 unchanged; GO 'muscle system process' top term (S3.3.p1)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: The only transcriptomic experiment is soleus RNA-seq of control vs muscle-specific STARD7 KO mice (S2.5.p1, S3.3.p1, FLT.p3). Exercise appears only as an outcome/phenotyping assay (treadmill endurance S2.3.p1, lactate before/after a bout S2.4.p1) on separate cohorts (male n=6, female n=9, FLT.p2); the RNA-seq animals have no exercise vs sedentary contrast.

checks: GEO contact Yasuhiro Horibata, Dokkyo Medical University = corresponding author/affiliation
6 soleus samples, WT x3 and mKO x3 = paper S2.5.p1 'three biological replicates per group'
DA.p1 says RNA-seq will be deposited in GEO (accession not named in the preprint)

ownership.reasoning: Submitter, tissue, genotype groups and replicate numbers match the paper; the paper does not cite the accession (DA.p1, deposited on acceptance), so ownership rests on these matching facts.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns are GSM ids with the library file stem appended; the regex keeps the GSM id and matches geo_accession exactly (6/6). The genotype column is aliased to a formula-safe name.

matrix.recommended_method: limma (log2(TPM+1)); edgeR on counts not possible from deposited files

final.source: GSE327036_RAW.tar: per-sample CLC files GSM*_Horibata_*_GE_.txt.gz with columns 'Name','TPM'; merged by the runner into GSE327036_merged_from_tar.csv
final.paper_input: edgeR with filterByExpr on CLC read counts (FLT.p3); TPM/log2(TPM+1) for PCA/heatmap (S2.5.p1)

matrix.reasoning: Each per-sample file has header 'Name\tTPM' and the values of a sample sum to 1e6; integer fraction 0.54 with fractional values. GEO data_processing says 'raw gene counts', which contradicts the file contents; the file header and per-sample sums decide: TPM. Counts for the paper's edgeR route are not deposited.

final.available_contrast: genotype mKO vs WT (not an exercise contrast)

candidates.reason_rejected: genotype (STARD7 KO) is not an exercise intervention; none of the 6 RNA-seq animals was assigned to exercise vs sedentary, so the exercise estimand the request asks for is not identified

candidates.value: treat reduced endurance of mKO as an exercise proxy
candidates.reason_rejected: endurance capacity is a phenotypic outcome measured on separate cohorts (FLT.p2); it is not a manipulated exercise exposure of the sequenced samples

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast: GSE327036 contains only WT vs STARD7 muscle-KO soleus (3 vs 3) at baseline; exercise (treadmill) was a phenotyping test on other animals, so the data cannot identify an effect of exercise on gene expression.
design.reasoning: The request is the effect of exercise on gene expression as the paper intends. The paper's RNA-seq estimand is a genotype effect (S3.3.p1, FLT.p3); the only grouping column is genotype (WT 3 / mKO 3) and tissue is constant (soleus). No exercise, training, time-after-bout or sedentary label exists in metadata or paper for these samples. Refused at design.

discrepancies.paper: edgeR on read counts after filterByExpr (FLT.p3)
discrepancies.data: GEO data_processing claims raw gene counts, but every per-sample file holds a single TPM column (header 'TPM', sums 1e6)
discrepancies.disposition: recorded; would block the paper's edgeR route (case stopped before method)

discrepancies.paper: GRCm38 release-94, CLC Genomics Workbench v22.0.1 (S2.5.p1)
discrepancies.data: GRCm39, CLC Genomics Workbench v23.0.2 (GEO data_processing)
discrepancies.disposition: recorded; does not affect the refusal
